AUTHOR: Jalal
TITLE: DeepFins: Capturing dynamics in underwater videos for fish detection
REGION: Australia (OzFish, AIMS; diverse locations); Taiwan coral reefs (Fish4Knowledge / LifeCLEF 2015)
SPECIES: Fish (single class); OzFish >500 species, LifeCLEF 2015 15 species — species not classified
DATA: OzFish (AIMS): 1,758 originally annotated frames + 8,185 newly annotated = 9,943 frames from >3,000 videos (Detection_Set), plus ~3 s Clips_Set; LifeCLEF 2015 (Fish4Knowledge subset): 93 annotated videos
V_EV: Sec. 2.1.1: 'The dataset presents challenges related to luminosity variations, contrast, blurriness, fish camouflage, moving background elements like plants and corals, and water turbidity'. Words only; no measurement or visibility-stratified results.
D_EV: Sec. 2.1.1: 'it is ensured that frames from the same video are included in only one of the three splits (training, validation, or test)'
R_EV: Table 2: 'Evaluation of model trained on Ozfish training set and tested on LifeCLEF 2015 test set and vice versa.' (F1 80.2/83.7 vs in-domain 90.0)
C_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'At the inference stage, a confidence threshold of 0.6 filters out low-probability detections, prioritizing precision.'
E_EV: Sec. 3: 'Fish detection accuracy is measured using the F1 Score' — Tables 1–3 report precision, recall, F1 only; relative abundance mentioned only as a potential application.
ARCH: DeepFins: YOLOv11 detector + Horn–Schunck optical-flow motion segmentation with direction-based clustering and blob analysis + YOLOv11 binary fish/non-fish classification head + preferential merging; ResNet/ResNeXt/MobileNetV3 with SSD/Faster R-CNN compared
METR: Precision, recall, F1 score; inference time per crop/frame
NOTE: PLAT=혼합 reflects two datasets: Fish4Knowledge/LifeCLEF 2015 is explicitly 'stationary cameras'; the OzFish platform is not described in the text (it is a BRUV dataset per AIMS, but the paper does not say so). Video-grouped 80/10/10 split explicitly stated; Sec. 3.1 also mentions a '60% training, 20% validation, and 20% testing' split in an earlier run (F1 75.2/69.4) before combining train+val — a verifier may wish to check which split underlies Table 1. 8,185 additional OzFish frames were annotated by the authors. Cross-dataset evaluation in both directions with identical hyperparameters → R1=Y, R2=복수 (region, camera system, species composition), R3=Y. C_ALL=N: a fixed 0.6 confidence threshold is used as-is; false alarms are discussed only qualitatively as a design motivation (motion-module false detections, Fig. 10 hard negatives) with no FP-rate verification or threshold sensitivity — a verifier might consider P. YOLOv11 described as ImageNet-pretrained (PRE=ImageNet). No code link; 'Data will be made available on request'.
